reconciliation.question: Reconciliation between test_upstream_hypothesis_audit.py (14/14 passing) and 5 historical change-detector failures
reconciliation.explanation: The two test scopes are completely distinct. test_upstream_hypothesis_audit.py evaluates 14 unit tests governing hypothesis coercion boundaries, Sidak multiple-testing persistence, and conditionality invariant rules. All 14 tests execute and pass completely (14/14 OK). The 5 historical change-detector failures reside in 4 separate historical test modules that specifically assert byte-exact match of legacy strategy files against an uncommitted pre-Phase-4 Windows CRLF digest (c52e648c...). These 5 tests fail because the working tree canonical LF hash is ba17582d... (and raw disk 9c56f3ff...). Per safety rule #7, historical pins are never rewritten, and these failures are contractually preserved under BLOCK-172-01.
